text: The cleanup deletes the unused pageLoading writes, while pageLoaded remains the consumed state. Content tabs update it for network load transitions, the address book waits for about-addressbook-ready, and preferences waits for paneSelected. These signals have different meanings; removing a redundant field does not unify readiness or wait for later asynchronous pane selection.
title: Removing pageLoading leaves tab-specific pageLoaded readiness signals intact
